## Publish gate report: Assam Breakfast, product page

**Going out:** product page copy for Assam Breakfast (UK, Pebblebrook Tea Co.). No send date was given.

**Checks**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "malty, full-bodied black tea" | Product fact, fine as written. |
| "noticeably smoother than supermarket tea bags" | **Unproven.** It's a comparison with no source, and it's not on the policy list. Remove it or soften it. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On the policy list, fine. |
| "100g tin, makes around 40 cups" | Product fact (size and brewing), fine. "Around" is an appropriate qualifier. |

- **Regulated claims:** The comparison is the only risky line. There are no health, money, environment, price or children claims. The organic claim matches the policy wording.
- **House style:** Clean and plain, with no AI tells or banned phrases. The policy has no voice section, so I can't score it numerically.
- **Disclosure:** None needed. It's the brand's own product page, with no ad, affiliate, sponsorship or AI-label trigger.

**Fixed:** Nothing changed yet. I'd rather you pick the replacement for the comparison than have me guess.

**Needs a decision**
- Suggested rewrite, which drops the comparison and keeps the flavour description:
  > Assam Breakfast. A malty, full-bodied black tea with a smooth finish. Certified organic by the Soil Association. 100g tin, makes around 40 cups.
  
  "Smooth finish" is a taste description, so it falls under product facts. If you want to keep "smoother than supermarket tea bags", I need a current, like-for-like source, such as a taste test, and the policy would need to allow comparisons. Without that it stays out.
- Because the copy changes, it needs a fresh check and approval on the final wording.

**Approver:** The policy doesn't name one, so I need an explicit yes from you to the exact final text. I haven't recorded any approval.

**Evidence log rows (for pasting)**

| Date | Content | Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-17 | Assam Breakfast product page | Certified organic by the Soil Association | On policy list | Brand policy |
| 2026-11-17 | Assam Breakfast product page | noticeably smoother than supermarket tea bags | Unproven, remove or soften | None |
| 2026-11-17 | Assam Breakfast product page | 100g tin, makes around 40 cups | Product fact | Brand policy (product facts) |

**Verdict:** Hold. Don't publish until the comparison is out and you approve the final text.
